## X-Sense Home Security v1.5.0

This release rolls up recent playback and Home Assistant compatibility improvements.

### Recording Playback
- Updates the browser HLS playback component used by the X-Sense Recordings panel.

### Home Assistant Compatibility
- Updates integration compatibility work for current Home Assistant schema and validation internals while retaining support for the declared Home Assistant minimum version.

### Maintenance
- Updates supported development and release dependencies, including the browser playback bundle.
